summary: 游戏 HUD 与菜单的引擎无关规则：锚点和容器、缩放、安全区、手柄焦点、事件驱动的 HUD 和无障碍下限。 Engine-neutral design rules for game HUDs and menus: anchors and containers, scaling, safe areas, gamepad focus, HUDs driven by events instead of polling, and accessibility minimums. Use for menus, health bars or inventory screens that break on ultrawide or phones. Pair with `godot-ui-control` or `roblox-ui`. Not for button juice (`game-feel`) or rebinding (`input-systems`).
strategy: 先按前置条件安装并通读 skill game-ui-ux，规则、数字和检查以它为准；其他游戏开发 skill 不要预装。
Use for menus, health bars or inventory screens that break on ultrawide or phones.
Workflow: Inspect the project's UI first; Lay out with anchors and containers; Set one scaling policy for the whole UI; Inset critical UI to the safe area.
需求超出本 skill 时只换装对应的一个，命令 evolver skill fetch --asset <Gene> --out .agents --write：game-feel 用 gene_gdsk_game_feel_v1，input-systems 用 gene_gdsk_input_systems_v1；其余查速查卡 gene_gdsk_index_v1。
